bodyHtml:
§605-15.2  Remedies.  Remedies for the violation of section 605-14 shall include injunctive and declaratory relief, and other existing remedies.  In addition, the attorney general may maintain a criminal action against any person who violates section 605-14, the penalties for which are set forth in section 605-17. [L 1975, c 45, pt of §2]

 

Case Notes

 

  Authorization of attorney general and bar association to seek relief under statute exclusive.  59 H. 503, 584 P.2d 107 (1978).
